scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem covers two specific infinite distance-four parity-extended BCH families from arXiv:2510.22259v1. It does not determine the covering radii of the paper's Section 5 distance-four family or its distance-six families. The infinite proof uses the source paper's exact two-weight dual enumerators together with the standard Delsarte external-distance bound; finite syndrome enumeration in verify.py is only a sanity check for two anchor cases. Focused literature and database searches cannot prove global novelty, and an older unindexed equivalent statement remains a residual risk.
title: Covering radius three for two extended two-weight BCH families
